A small maintenance release: crashes now leave a report, plus dependency and project upkeep.

## What changed

- A panic in the window or the collector now leaves a report (time, version, thread, message, source location, backtrace) in `~/.local/state/hwglance/crash.log`. Before, the message went to stderr only, which is lost when the window starts from the desktop launcher. The window also sends it to the journal (`journalctl --user -t hwglance`); the collector's report is in its own log (`journalctl --user -u hwglanced`). Please include it in bug reports.
- `hwglance --version` prints the window's version (the collector already had it).
- The `toml` crate is updated to 1.1.
- Project upkeep: dependency checks with `cargo-deny` in CI and weekly, Dependabot updates, pinned and read-only GitHub Actions, and a security policy, maintainer runbook and issue forms.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance/blob/v0.1.1/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install or update

Arch Linux, from the package attached below:

```sh
sudo pacman -U hwglance-0.1.1-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
systemctl --user restart hwglanced
sudo systemctl restart hwglance-helper   # if you use the optional helper
hwglance-bar-widget update               # Omarchy only, if you installed the widget
```

For a first install, enable the services instead: `systemctl --user enable --now hwglanced` and, optionally, `sudo systemctl enable --now hwglance-helper`, then `hwglance-bar-widget install` on Omarchy.

Other x86_64 Linux distributions, from the tarball (prebuilt, no Rust needed):

```sh
tar -xzf hwglance-0.1.1-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
cd hwglance-0.1.1-x86_64-linux
./install.sh
```

Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. Requirements and optional components are in the [README](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance#what-you-need).
